The sac is the strain's signature silhouette and must read instantly; the shoulders stay lightly armoured and delicate compared with the runner. No head, no arms, no claws, no legs, no tail, no spray, no liquid outside the sac. Straight overhead orthographic zenith camera looking down on the top of the part, forward (the creature's front) is up, no perspective, no cast shadow, no ground, no floor, no border, no text, no labels, no watermark. Genuine transparent background outside the silhouette, including any negative space. Crisp hand-painted 2D strategy-game sprite matching the existing swarm creature in the material reference: dark charcoal-purple segmented chitin, organic gunmetal-green ridges and under-plates, restrained bone-grey claw and plate edges, tiny warm amber sensory nodes. It will be shown only about 40 to 90 pixels wide in play, so keep bold readable plate shapes, clear dark separations and strong value contrast rather than fine noise. Change only material, detail and subtle ambient shading; never the silhouette, placement, scale or the transparent space. The pale yellow dots in the guide mark where small glowing nodes go; they are not shapes to copy literally.
